claims: The "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" premieres on Disney+ and Hulu on March 24, 2026.
The Hannah Montana show debuted in 2006.
The "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" was filmed before a live studio audience.
The "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" features an in-depth interview with Miley Cyrus hosted by Alex Cooper.
The "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" features archival footage.
The "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" features a musical performance.
March 24, 2026 is exactly 20 years from the original premiere of the Hannah Montana show.

The "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" is produced by HopeTown Entertainment and Unwell Productions.
